affected_component: workspace_bundle.manifest_divergence rows gain `locus` (+_divergence_locus); reproducibility-probe diagnostics and preflight golden detail render path=KIND@locus
invariant: A divergence row does not stop at the file path: for a zip container it names the first member whose bytes differ (or the member present on one side only), for a UTF-8 text file the first differing line number with a bounded excerpt of the ACTUAL side only (the producer's own output — expected-side bytes are never quoted), and nothing for other binaries. The reproducibility probe and the preflight golden mismatch carry that locus in their public diagnostics, so a reference repair pins the real source of drift (a docProps stamp, a generated element id) instead of guessing.
